Associations create change. We amplify it.

About the role

Onboarding is where a customer’s relationship with us really begins, and we’re looking for a people-centered Onboarding Specialist to lead new customers through their onboarding journey with Novi AMS . This is a project and change management role: you will guide multiple simultaneous customers from kickoff through go-live, managing the moving parts of each project while helping customer teams navigate the change that comes with adopting new software.
You will own the customer experience across onboarding, act as a trusted advisor to customer teams, and coordinate closely with internal teams to keep every project moving. The ideal candidate combines strong project and change management skills with sharp problem-solving, a consultative mindset, empathy, facilitation ability, and a bias toward anticipating problems before they arise. In short, you’ll pair structure with empathy, keeping projects on track while helping customers feel confident every step of the way.

What you’ll do

Customer Onboarding Project Leadership

• Lead several customer onboarding projects simultaneously, from kickoff through go-live, managing scope, timeline, milestones, and deliverables for each.

• Build and maintain project plans in Rocketlane, tracking progress, dependencies, and risks across concurrent projects.

• Facilitate kickoff, status, and milestone meetings with clear agendas, decisions, and next steps.

• Coach customer teams through adoption, addressing hesitation and building buy-in across stakeholders.

• Act as a consultant to customers, recommending best practices and helping them make informed decisions about their configuration and processes.

• Train new customers on Novi AMS , so they leave onboarding confident and self-sufficient.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Coordinate handoff from Sales at kickoff and to the Support and Success teams at go-live, so customers experience one continuous relationship with Novi.

• Partner with Data, Content Migration, Support, and other internal teams to coordinate handoffs and keep onboarding projects moving.

• Surface product feedback and feature requests from onboarding conversations so customer insight reaches the right teams.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of onboarding playbooks, templates, and standards.

Are you eager to develop your excellence in an inclusive, collaborative, and empowering community? Are you excited about joining a company that strives to make a difference - for its employees, clients, and society? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature?
If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment & Health team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.
Your new role
We invite you to bring your geological experience into play as you support existing environmental investigation and remediation projects in the New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Metropolitan New York areas. In this position, the selected candidate will collaborate with numerous teams and will work closely with Professional Geologists (PGs) and Licensed Site Remediation Professionals (LSRPs). Our team is committed to providing mentorship and skill development as key components for your career advancement. Also, there will be opportunity to engage with Engineers, and other technical experts on a variety of projects, which include geologic and environmental investigation, data evaluation, modelling, and reporting.
Your key responsibilities will be:

• Execute geologic and site investigations, environmental sampling, and other field tasks in support of key projects/programs, including Remedial Investigations, Feasibility Studies, Remedial Designs, Remedial Actions, and post-remediation OM&M. Complete and review detailed and accurate field and project documentation. Assist in successfully tracking field task activities related to scope, schedule, and budget.

• Provide geologic support for the remediation of contaminated soils, sediments, surface water and groundwater involving remedies such as excavation, capping, containment, in-situ and ex-situ treatment, and subsurface vapor mitigation.

• Coordinate and manage geologic and site investigation tasks supporting Project Managers, PGs, LSRPs, and engineers. Coordinate tasks and support the development of technical reports ( e.g. , regulatory reports, work plans, technical memos, and presentations) pursuant to regulatory requirements.

• Provide project support with the development of scopes of work, planning, and implementation of routine tasks including, but not limited to, soil, groundwater, and vapor sampling efforts.

• Collaborate with teams made up of Engineers, Geologists, and Scientists. Serve as mentor to Early-Career Geological Scientists. Grow your capabilities and skills.

About you:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology or Geological Science

• 5+ years of relevant experience in environmental site investigation and characterization, remediation experience is a plus. Possession, eligibility, or interest in obtaining a PG license and/or LSRP.

• 40-Hour OSHA HAZWOPER certification and up-to-date 8-hour refresher.

• Experience supervising a variety of drilling techniques for site investigation. Working knowledge of federal, PA, NJ, and NY environmental and site remediation regulations.

• Geologic and environmental data evaluation and reporting experience.

• Meaningful, high-impact work

• Flexible and hybrid work arrangements

• Competitive compensation and benefits

• Professional development and leadership opportunities

• A collaborative and inclusive culture

• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
